==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Before I went to sleep, I focused on trying to mentally contact an alien to enter my dreams. When I actually started dreaming, the dream seemed to heavily focus on Skywatcher. Skywatcher is an organization that claims to attempt to summon and study UFOs.

In my dream, the UFOs studied by Skywatcher looked less like eggs and more like blue, ethereal, humanoid beings. This made the summonings look significantly more supernatural than they already appear. I distinctly remember one of the UFOs seemingly having long blonde hair and floating high in the sky.

One element of my dream that really stood out to me, was that the Skywatcher team was a lot bigger. There was an entire division of the Psionics Team that was focused on studying possible mythological connections to UFOs. This team called themselves the Oni Squad.
